proxies._doctrine: Proxies for not running the src code. Species signal = CONTENT, never name.
proxies.demo: scripted showcase mainloop performing canned output
proxies.runner: wrapper that invokes other scripts instead of being the app
proxies.pathhack: sys.path.insert/append to fake the import environment
proxies.git: .git/ internals — recorded claims about code, not code

predicates._note: Item 3 (2026-09-10): prose mirror of no_aivalidator/artifact_scanner/proxies.py — CONTENT only; `in_degree` = importers within the target, measured once by the scanner; 'top level' = module body + the `if __name__ == '__main__':` block. Precedence: test > pathhack > git > runner > entry_shim > demo > assertion_only > setup > package_marker; every match kept in `also`. Published as the `species` fact: '' | 'test' | 'proxy:<kind>' — the disposition table's context fact.
predicates.pathhack: sys.path.insert/append/extend, sys.path[...] = or os.environ['PYTHONPATH'] = at top level PRECEDING an import, and in_degree == 0 (the same mutation inside an imported file stays the path-hack detector's infraction, never a species)
predicates.git: imports git | pygit2 | dulwich, or a subprocess.* call whose first argument is a Constant/List starting 'git'; in_degree == 0
predicates.runner: a top-level call to subprocess.run/call/check_call/check_output/Popen, os.system, os.exec*, runpy.run_path/run_module, pytest.main, unittest.main; in_degree == 0
predicates.entry_shim: no def / class; the body is imports and at most one call expression (main(), sys.exit(main()), cli())
predicates.demo: every top-level call has only Constant / f-string-of-constant arguments (>= 1 such call) and no def / class of the file is referenced by another file
predicates.assertion_only: no test-framework import; every top-level def contains an assert and none returns a value; in_degree == 0
predicates.setup: a top-level setup(...) call imported from setuptools / distutils
predicates.package_marker: __init__.py whose body is only imports / __all__ / __version__ (or a docstring)

filters._doctrine: Owner 2026-09-05: filter 1 = DETRITUS (unreachable modules), filter 2 = ARTIFACTS (everything below). Both feed ONE whitelist. The code reads this block; nothing here is hand-copied into code. Venvs are recognised by SHAPE + SIZE, never by name (rule 9). Stricken-name species are read from the existing dict-only lists at runtime and are never spelled in code.

venv_shape.owner_reference: average venv ~15 MB or ~45 MB (owner 2026-09-05); threshold 10 MB (owner 2026-08-28); size decides, shape corroborates, name never

filters.stricken_name_species: read at runtime from detritus.tool_caches.stricken_name_wild_only (the cache dir only); the harness-file naming convention is NOT auto-whitelisted — those are proxies, judged by content
filters._law: Two wild names carrying the stricken term were removed from these lists (rule 2). They are not filtered by name; if they matter they are judged by content.
filters._doctrine_python_only: Owner 2026-09-05 (evening): CodeRadar scans 100% PYTHON repos only. The only live source is a .py file; EVERY non-.py file is an artifact by construction (species 'non_python:<ext>' when no finer species matches) and is whitelisted, never drawn, never scanned, never hashed. The launcher discloses the composition (N .py / M non-.py) and refuses a target with zero .py files. Species below refine the disclosure only.

content_sniff._doctrine: content beats name: a file whose first bytes carry a known data-format header is that species whatever it is called

intent_sources._doctrine: Item 3 (2026-09-10): dot-dir / packaging / docs sources are read for INTENT and classified as artifacts for scanning; looked up by explicit path signatures from the target root (no dot-skip — FIX_13; no walk of their own — FIX_15). Facts are discrete; domain_keywords is an INTERSECTION (README / docs identifier tokens ∩ the target's module / def names), never a count threshold. Stubs are NOT intent sources: unimplemented, they may change. Handed to the intent file (Item 8) as IntentFact{fact, value, source, evidence}; published in the whitelist payload under intent_facts until that file exists.
